tagline: Independent oil and natural gas company engaged in the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquid reserves in South Texas.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Revenue is the primary indicator of the company's financial performance, reflecting its oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquid production activities in South Texas.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: Total Revenue represents the company's consolidated sales for fiscal year 2025.
kpis.signal: Stable revenue despite lower oil prices.

kpis.name: Oil Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of crude oil.
kpis.description: Oil revenues are a major component of total revenue, influenced by market prices and production volumes.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in oil revenues due to falling prices.

kpis.name: Natural Gas Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of natural gas.
kpis.description: Natural gas revenues experienced strong growth, partially offsetting the decline in oil revenues.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in natural gas revenues driven by price increases and higher production.

kpis.name: NGL Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of natural gas liquids (NGL).
kpis.description: Natural gas liquid revenues showed stable and predictable growth.
kpis.signal: Moderate NGL revenue growth, supported by increased production.

kpis.name: Total Operating Costs
kpis.explanation: Sum of all expenses related to the company's operations.
kpis.description: Operating costs increased, reflecting expansion of activities and gathering and processing costs.
kpis.signal: Increase in operating costs, primarily due to higher production and GTP costs.

kpis.name: Exploration Expenses
kpis.explanation: Expenses devoted to exploration and search for new resources.
kpis.description: Exploration expenses declined during the fiscal year, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.
kpis.signal: Notable decrease in exploration expenses, potentially related to a rationalization strategy.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Expenses to acquire or improve physical production assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are critical for expansion and maintenance of production operations.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided text.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates profitability of operations before other expenses are considered.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided text.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the efficiency of the company's operations management.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided text.

kpis.name: Average Daily Production
kpis.explanation: Average volume of oil and gas produced per day, expressed in thousands of barrels of oil equivalent.
kpis.description: Average daily production increased significantly to 99.8 Mboe/d, reflecting operational efficiency and asset development at Giddings.
kpis.signal: Notable increase in daily production, sign of operational growth.

kpis.name: Natural Gas Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of natural gas for the year.
kpis.description: The strong increase in natural gas revenues is a key element of year performance, rising from 90.3 to 190.3 million.
kpis.signal: Explosion in natural gas revenues, driven by prices and production.

kpis.name: Gathering, Transportation and Processing Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs related to delivering oil and natural gas to market, including gathering, transportation, and processing.
kpis.description: The increase in these costs is directly correlated with increased production activity, rising from 39.8 to 67.1 million year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Substantial increase in gathering, transportation, and processing costs, linked to higher production and natural gas prices.

risks.title: Security Threats
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions security threats, including cybersecurity threats, as a risk factor in its annual report.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Commodity price volatility is mentioned as a major risk factor, influenced by geopolitical and macroeconomic factors. This directly affects the company's operating results.

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.score_rationale: Changes in international and national regulations, particularly regarding energy and sanctions, can impact global supply, commodity prices, and operating costs.
